main_text.p:
4. Vt reliqui intereunt, paruam redigitur ad vrnā,
Ac saepe coeptis excidunt.

5. Quàm felix cuius Deus est fiducia sola,
Nec invocat alterum Deum!

6. Nā Deus excelsus terrā, mare, & astra creauit,
Promissáque obseruat sua.

7. Vindicat afflictos, alimentáque prabet egenis,
Soluit reorum compedes.

8. Restituit cæcis visum, extollítque iacentes,
Seruos timentes afferit.

9. Pupillos, viduas, peregrinos vsque tuetur,
Nisum malorum dissipat.

10. Rex tuus, euge Sio, Dominus per secula cuncta
Regnabit. Illi gloria.
main_text.head: PSALMVS CXLVII. CONstat 20. verf. Heb. totidem Latinis.
main_text.p:
1. Collaudate Deum, laus eius grata, benignis
Syncerisque animis nihil est iucundius
hymno.

2. Restituet Solymas arces, profugósque reducet
Iudaeos, reddétque suis cunabula prima.

3. Latificus Deus est qui consolatur egentes,
Afflictos recreat, laesorum vulnera nectit.

4. Vergilias, Helicē, Cynosuram, Arionis ensem
Supputat: & numeros stellis & nomina fecit.

5. O quanta est Domini virtus! sapientia quanta!
Vt circunspecta mundum ratione gubernat!

page.notes: Verse numbers in the first series are printed as 4–10 beside the lines; the top line of the page and the final catchword-like word "Prostra-" at the foot are as printed. Some words are doubtful: "vrnā" (printed as such, likely urna), "prabet" (prabet), "Nisum" (printed Nifum), "Vt circunspecta" (printed "Vt circunspecta"), "Heb. totidem Latinis" as printed. The page has no printed page-number-only lines beyond "240". Possible printing errors left as printed.
